critical_code_review_comments: routes/lead_gen.py:hunt_all_emails scopes query with vertical ∈ {salon,restaurant} and city regex ^<city>i — correct, matches spec. Label 'Email hunt — <city> <vertical>s no-email leads' is persisted into run.city, which satisfies the 'Bangalore restaurants' substring check.
routes/lead_gen.py:_extract_emails includes `'%' in low` early filter — this is the correct guard for URL-encoded junk; also chained with _SKIP_EMAIL / _SKIP_DOMAINS and 5-item cap.

routes/mira_outreach.py:auto_reply_to_lead ordering is: (1) auto_reply off OR no email -> 'off'; (2) already invited/demo/customer/unsubscribed -> 'already handled'; (3) _OPT_OUT_RE match -> write auto_reply_skipped=opt_out, log, return 'opt_out'; (4) draft + send; (5) update lead with demo_invite_sent_at + auto_replied + status demo; (6) write outreach log + mira event. Correct per spec. One nit: _OPT_OUT_RE is defined at module level with inline flag and only matches whole words — 'spam' as a bare word will trigger opt-out, which could over-match friendly emails mentioning 'spam filter'. Not critical.
